items.title: Notepad++ Hack Detailed Along With the IoCs and Custom Malware Used
items.description: A sophisticated espionage campaign attributed to the Chinese Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group Lotus Blossom (also known as Billbug). The threat actors compromised the infrastructure hosting the popular text editor Notepad++ to deliver a custom, previously undocumented backdoor named “Chrysalis”. This campaign, discovered by Rapid7 researcher Ivan Feigl, primarily targets organizations in…
